Episode 205. The Call of the Story (1)
Middle layer, the small city of the ancient beastmen, Firuol.
"Risrit was a great victory, Qyoon was a draw, and the Tower of Story was a huge defeat. Our predictions were accurate."
The emperor, Aylan Bement, said with a smile. The imperial family was satisfied with the results of the invasion.

"The results are due to Shimat's good use of persuading the Red Name Race to accept our opinion. If we had sent the airborne fortress, which was hard to operate, directly to the Tower of Story, we would have seen a situation like Drekhon again."
"It's unfortunate that we lost Drekhon, but it may have been a blessing in disguise, Manop. If Drekhon was in good health, the Red Name Race would have taken more time to listen to us."

"That's right, Your Majesty. It seems that those dull and arrogant creatures have finally come to their senses. Looking at them pleading for information about the Tower of Story when I communicated with Bibol earlier."
As Manop said, the Red Name Race requested communication with the imperial family as soon as the battle ended. They wanted to know what on earth happened in the Tower of Story.
The imperial family thoroughly informed them of what they knew about the magic stone and 'manipulation', and told them that the Tower of Story is the only place where Zipl can use his ability.
"The fact that the Red Name Race's fleet could not even escape suggests that Zipl's manipulation ability has begun to officially open."
"Since he didn't swallow Kellyak and Shinu, it's presumed that he is only at the entry stage. Even that was probably possible with the help of the shaman."

"Veradin will realize it too. That there is a limit to completing the magic stone with the power of the shaman. And he will also feel the pressure that the shaman may collude and betray with them, since the ultimate goal of the Red Name Race is also the resurrection of the Sun God. Although in reality, there's no such possibility……."
The imperial family was confident that there would be no alliance between the Sun God religion and the Red Name Race. This is because their goals to achieve through the Sun God were different.
What Sanna's faction wants is the perfection of the world as they perceive it.

Most immortals and mortals were not needed in that perfect world. Therefore, at the moment when Sanna completed her faith, the Red Name Race could not remain in the world. Not only the Red Name Race, but all those who did not receive 'selection' would disappear. Over 90% of the existing life in the world.
"For now, both the shaman and Veradin need each other, so they will not distance their relationship for a while."

"Anyway, the situation is going wonderfully. The Red Name Race and Zipl have no choice but to continue attrition warfare, and we continue to transfer more technology from the increasingly desperate Red Name Race. By the time we wake up Temar Runkandel and Elliot, we will no longer need to hide like this."
Just as Jin felt a bad premonition a while ago, the imperial family had been planning to clone him using Temar's left arm for a long time.
Furthermore, if they could also revive the Blue Spirit God Eltieot, which was kept during the Great Peak,

The Imperial Clan would suddenly have two Superhuman Martial Artists at its disposal. Moreover, with the information remaining in Temar's body and the technology of the Red Spirit Race, they could even create Mine into the strongest biological golem.
Their goal was to engulf the weakened Zhipil and Red Spirit Race in war.
This was the first goal of the Imperial Clan, with a particular interest in Zhipil. Except for the Sun God, there was no authority to surpass a complete level of history manipulation anywhere else.

If they could get their hands on that power, there would be no problem dealing with the Luncandell and Barmel alliance or Kinzello in the future. Even to the point of corroding the entire underground world.
Imagining the future, the Imperial Clan was getting lost in their dreams.
"I need to go check on Eltieot. Prepare for it."
"Yes, Your Highness!"
Zhipil, the Tower of Tales.

Two days had passed since the first official battle between the Red Spirit Race and Zhipil ended. However, Beradin was still unable to manipulate the minds of the captured Bilka and Red Spirit Race members.
"Grrr, kahak...!"
"Maiden! The Lord has been like this for two days. Haven't you found a solution yet? Why isn't the opening of the Demon Stone being released?"
Octavia screamed while watching Beradin writhing in pain. She too was severely injured from Lisrit, but she was worried about Beradin and could not concentrate on recovery.
"I'm sorry, Ghost Captain. This is completely unknown to me. I have been praying continuously, but my faith has not reached yet."
For Octavia, it was a frustrating situation.

Unlike other areas, the Lord, who was declared victorious, was unexpectedly in such a condition. The Maiden kept mumbling prayers, not hiding her confusion, and no one in the clan knew how to improve Beradin's condition.
Moreover, they didn't know when the Red Spirit Race might suddenly invade. Satyr and Ronil, as well as other leaders, could not leave the Tower of Tales.

Because if Beradin was to go berserk, they were the only ones who could stop him. Even the idea that 'they can stop him' was merely wishful thinking. What's making Beradin unstable now was not only due to individual ability but also due to the power of the Demon Stone.

The Demon Stone was still located in the middle of the split Tower of Tales. The executives attempted to release the opening several times, but each time, Beradin's condition only became more precarious.

'Why is this happening? It is clear that infusing a little of our sect's power from the Sun God into the Demon Stone is not a problem. His power can be fused with anything without any reaction... The likelihood is that this is a problem with Beradin Zhipil, not the Demon Stone.'
Sanna, like the leaders of Zhipil, was in a state of unrest. If anything went wrong with Beradin, he would be the one to bear full responsibility.
Furthermore, Beradin's problem could lead to the collapse of Zhipil as a whole, and in that case, Sanna would lose the most critical piece for the resurrection of the Sun God.
'Should I gather the priests first and prepare for a rampage? If so, exposing the full force of the sect is inevitable. Kinzello, please give me an answer. How can I solve this situation...!'
While everyone was in turmoil, Beradin continued to scream, and the Demon Stone visible through the window seemed to be reaching its limit.
"The expansion of the Demon Stone is accelerating. Although it's impossible to predict exactly, if it continues like this, it will soon explode."
Ronil said, touching his forehead.
"If the Demon Stone explodes, everything we have done so far will be in vain."
"Beyond that, the entire area might disappear without a trace. We might need to make a decision. To subjugate the clan...."
"What are you saying, Satyr?"
"We might need to evacuate, leaving the Lord behind. If everyone gathered in the Tower of Tales now dies, the clan will perish. It's a desperate choice, but certainly, the Lord would not want that."
"Is that what you have to say!"
"It's reality, Ghost Captain. Also, the Lord once told me that if something went wrong with him, the Ghost Captain should become the Lord...."

"What's important to me isn't becoming the Lord or something. If that was important, wouldn't I have acted before Beradin when my brother was dying? The only thing that matters is Zhipil itself! Anyway, if we lose Beradin and the Demon Stone now, it's the end for the clan. If we die, we die together, and if we live, we live together."
"Great Aunt!"
"Ronil, do you agree with this kid?"
"The Lord once said the same thing to me."
"Shut up! There's no giving up on Beradin. As you all know, I still can't understand the process of Beradin ascending to the throne. But now, this child is our only hope. We won't leave him behind."
Octavia's angry voice echoed throughout the tower.

'Maybe killing Beradin Zhipil is the answer. If we kill him and another executive takes the Demon Stone, the situation might improve! Surely, this must be a problem with Beradin, not the Demon Stone!'
And Sanna was reaching such a conclusion.
"I think the Inquisitor is right, Ghost Captain. I will stay until the end to pray, the rest of you should leave."
"I'm staying. Those who want to believe the Shamaness and leave should leave."
Sanna didn't dissuade Octavia further. When the executives left and they killed Beradin, dealing with the injured Octavia wouldn't be a problem.
The executives decided they had to take Octavia with them by any means.
"...I'm sorry, Great Aunt. Please forgive us for doing this. Since the Lord has chosen you as the next Lord, we can't stand by and watch you die."
So, at the moment when Satyrin was about to restrain Octavia.
Suddenly, Beradin's convulsions lessened. The Demon Stone, which seemed to burst with swelling, quickly stabilized, and those around watched with wide-eyed surprise.
"Lord!"
"Lord!"
Beradin looked at the Shamaness and the executives, sweating coldly as if he had regained his senses.
"Are you alright!"
"I'm fine. My pain for the past two days was not a problem of mine or the Demon Stone's, so you all can rest assured now."
He calmly explained his situation. He wiped his forehead, gulped down the water on the table, and even managed to give a faint smile.
"Lord?"
"Please explain in detail. We've been worrying if this is how our clan ends."

"You call me by name when you're desperate, but then you honorific again, Great Aunt. I've never mentioned this since becoming Lord, but you can still treat me casually like before. In fact, every time I hear your polite speech, I somehow feel a little uncomfortable."
"Explain what happened."
"The Tower. The Tower of Tales was summoning a being through me and the Demon Stone. That's why I fell into a coma. It was totally unexpected, but it brought an enormous fortune."
"The Tower of Tales called someone through you...?"
Putting down his cup, Beradin gave this response.
"....Elona Zhipil. The Tower of Tales has broken her seal. Soon, she will return to our clan."
